provenance.owner_boundaries: The charge helpers and their three lifecycle callbacks share only the charge state run, while the following map-card helpers and map-inspection callbacks share only the map-card state run. No cross-family calls, shared state or external state consumers exist. The old mixed mode_ms2 boundary was introduced by the generated module assignment. Original code runs, independent ROM groups and RAM order are reproduced by the two natural C owners in all three versions. The two charge state halfwords use the existing signed lifecycle declarations and original signed loads. Scalar map text lengths use a local result before storage, replacing incompatible array declarations.
provenance.native_tables: Four five-language selectors belong to charge and seven belong to map inspection. They occur immediately before the respective mode records in the original EU initialized-data spans; no counterpart definitions are invented for US or JP. The five map-category records belong to map inspection. Four halfword card-kind values are bounded by the explicit four-iteration classification loop. EU adds five halfword tile lengths indexed by the five-language domain. These readonly definitions precede the map-inspection name with native alignment, replacing their raw binary fragment. Every former object contract retains its original address, size and digest evidence.
provenance.moogle_tables: The shop has four selectable menu records and four pack sprite resources, with sentinel navigation IDs -1 and5 handled before indexing. Its three card-category descriptors contain explicit counts17,14,7 whose16-byte record arrays partition the exact contiguous native span. Each record uses the native script condition pointer and four probability weights. The random-value selector reads exactly ten weights totaling100. Floor table13x4x4 is bounded by the thirteen game floors and explicit inner loops; four pack types and four quality slots bound the4x4 price matrix. The five map-card category records include the special category4 referenced by map inspection. World-warp type selection wraps0..2 and therefore owns precisely three halfwords before the separate mode name, excluding two alignment bytes. Canonical structs retain actual native pointer fields; encoded resource and condition-script bytes remain assets.
provenance.language_slots: Thirty native EU-only arrays each contain five language-selected pointers. Bounds come from the five-language domain and distinct roots in poo,allmap,title,status,mode_worldwarp,mode_ms,mode_ms2,ms_charge and mode_mapinspect. These are runtime locale selectors, not encoded assets. There are no US/JP counterpart definitions or interpolated spans.
provenance.table_targets: Nested title/status/resource selectors use void**[5], and the map-inspect animation selector uses AnimHeader**[5]. Every nested target is a separately source-owned real array (actor_ui_resource_data,remaining_resource_data or animation_resource_data), never a byte-view alias. status.c explicitly selects gfx0,1,2 from the EC8 family and GetMaxSpriteTileBytes(...,4) bounds the F08 family. Title uses three gfx slots; room/map-inspect tables have independent animation frame bounds. Existing raw encoded-asset bindings are reused when available; remaining native tile/map/Sprite labels point to original payloads and are not counted as C-owned data.
provenance.direct_consumers: Two Pooh u8-pointer selectors supply floor-indexed0x140-byte graphics. Allmap and shop map selectors feed LoadBgMap/RequestTilemapRectCopy. Status selectors feed LoadObjTiles,DrawSprite and counted graphics arrays. Worldwarp and mode_ms2 direct Sprite selectors feed DrawSprite; each of their45 pointed-to Sprite streams independently parses to its complete2+6*count byte extent. Existing raw references and region guards remain unchanged except removing now-canonical TU-local extern declarations.
